standardValue.description: You've contacted the prospect and they're interested.
standardValue.label: Qualification

standardValue.description: You're developing a sales proposal for the prospect.
standardValue.label: Proposal

standardValue.description: You're working with the prospect on the proposal you delivered.
standardValue.label: Negotiation

standardValue.description: Early research on a foundation or government grant before an LOI is submitted. Default open stage on the Grant Pipeline. Probability 10%.
standardValue.label: Prospecting

standardValue.description: Letter of Intent has been sent to the funder. Set LOI Submitted Date manually. Open stage at 20%. Counts toward the LOI Success Rate denominator.
standardValue.label: LOI Submitted

standardValue.description: Funder invited a full proposal after the LOI. Set LOI Outcome to Accepted manually. Open stage at 50%. Counts toward the LOI Success Rate numerator.
standardValue.label: LOI Accepted - Full Proposal Invited

standardValue.description: Funder declined the Letter of Intent. Probability 0%. Distinct from Declined, which is a loss after full proposal. Left open so it appears on the Grant Path in sequence. Do not clear Re-approach Eligibility Date or Next Open Cycle Date - those remain for future-cycle planning.
standardValue.label: LOI Declined

standardValue.description: Full proposal has been submitted to the funder. Open stage at 75%.
standardValue.label: Full Proposal Submitted

standardValue.description: Grant has been awarded and is in its period of performance. Left open at 100% so the record stays workable until Closed - Complete. Distinct from Closed - Complete, which is used when the grant is fully closed out.
standardValue.label: Awarded - Active

standardValue.description: Funder declined the full proposal or later request. Probability 0%. Distinct from LOI Declined. Left open so it appears on the Grant Path in sequence. Do not clear Re-approach Eligibility Date or Next Open Cycle Date.
standardValue.label: Declined

standardValue.description: The grant ran its full period of performance and is closed out - reporting done, no further action. Probability 100%. Left open on the stage definition so Grant Path can show Closed - Complete as its own step instead of a Closed dropdown. The Grant Renewal Alert flow still treats this stage name as terminal and suppresses the 6-month renewal reminder.
standardValue.label: Closed - Complete
